title: RecoveryRequestView
description: Projection of imagodei RecoveryRequest DHT entry (modernized). Source of truth: DHT.

humanId.description: Coordinator-populated resolution of humanAgentPubkey to the legacy String human_id used by HumanityWitness/HumanRelationship/IdentityFreeze. Null accepted at request commit; required by the time a KeyRotation is attempted for IntimateQuorum rotations or when a freeze may apply.

requiredWitnessCount.description: Coordinator-computed threshold for IntimateQuorum authority. Computed as ceil(emergency_contact_count / 2) + 1 at request time, floored at 2. Validator enforces distinct-witness-author count >= this value at KeyRotation commit.
